sources.citation: Lobel, Jason William. 2013. Philippine and North Bornean languages: issues in description, subgrouping, and reconstruction. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. Ch. 11 'Southwest Sabah Revisited', pp. 359-403 (= Glottolog ref 318351; journal version = Oceanic Linguistics 52(1):36-68, ref 471242).
sources.note: Nothing for Abai. Abai Sembuak / Abai Tubu appear only in the subgrouping argument (pp. 359-360 fn.3 identity; sec. 11.4.5 p.398) and in functor/sound-reflex tables where forms are cited without accent marks; the only 'stress' token in ch. 11 is a Blust quote about PMP schwa (p.367). Elsewhere the dissertation discusses contrastive accent only for Philippine languages (8.2.9; p.287 fn.3 on Mindanao).
